textDesc: EVA-upper platform clogs with closed toes, vent openings and a visible pivot strap. The sculpted platform silhouette is shown in the actual product photographs. Choose Blue, Khaki, Beige, Light Pink or Black and three paired size labels: 35-36, 37-38 and 39-40. Separate lining, midsole and ground-contact outsole materials are not specified. Send colour-size quantities, fit requirements and destination to confirm order details.

companyFaqDesc: The upper is EVA. Separate lining, midsole and ground-contact outsole formulations are not specified. Send any material requirements for confirmation before order.
Which colours and sizes can I request?
Blue, Khaki, Beige, Light Pink and Black. Size choices are the three paired labels 35-36, 37-38 and 39-40. Send your size mix and fit requirements; US or UK size conversions are confirmed separately.
What are the MOQ and reference price tiers?
MOQ is 2 pairs. Reference price is USD 5.16 for 2-49 pairs, USD 4.81 for 50-99 pairs and USD 4.47 for 100 pairs or more. Freight and final order terms are confirmed separately.
How do I check fit and strap requirements?
The pictures show the pivot strap in its forward position. Share your fit measurements and intended use so size selection and strap requirements can be confirmed for your order.
Can I request samples or custom packaging?
Send your sample quantity, branding and packing requirements. Feasibility, charges, minimum quantities and timing are assessed before quotation.
How are availability and dispatch confirmed?
Send colour-size quantities, destination and required date. Availability, packing, freight options and dispatch timing are confirmed against the agreed order.
